VCST-5733 case #21  the ACCOUNT-STATE gate fixture. vc-module-sales-rep PR #14 wires EnsureAuthenticatedAsync -> IUserManagerCore.CheckCurrentUserState into SalesRepQueryBuilder.BeforeMediatorSend, so EVERY sales-rep query re-checks the account state at QUERY time rather than trusting the token claims. Exercising that gate needs an account that is UNLOCKED when the token is issued and LOCKED when the query runs, which SR_REP_BLOCKED cannot do (it is already locked, so /connect/token refuses it outright and the GraphQL layer is never reached). This rep exists ONLY for that mid-session transition: it is UNLOCKED AT REST, and npm run sr:lock / sr:unlock toggles it. It is a DEDICATED rep on purpose  every other rep is load-bearing for a case that needs it unlocked (PRIMARY for ~40 cases in 050m/089/091/093, ACME2+ACME3 for the SR-GQL-004 >=3-active-reps paging premise, EXCLUSIVE_TECHFLOW for cross-org exclusion, LAYOUT for the 091/093 Save cases, NOCUSTOMERS for the empty-state redirect), so locking any of them would break a sibling suite. Teardown is automatic and needs no extra step: is_locked=false makes repFixtureStatus() Approved, so clearRepStaleLockout() -> hasStaleLockout() clears any lockoutEnd + accessFailedCount on EVERY reseed.
